liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Foolish Heart** (2 reviews): Reviewer found Foolish Heart great; Garcia sounds exhausted during the Foolish Heart refrain, as if he needed a week of sleep [14][16]
- **Feel Like a Stranger** (1 review): Reviewer says the jam peaks without Garcia audible [7]
- **Althea** (1 review): Reviewer got into the venue around the middle of Althea after traffic turned out to be the parking lot filling [9]
- **Deal** (1 review): Reviewer says Garcia is missing even from Deal, normally a reliable jam tune [7]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Uncle John's Band in the second set sick [6]
- **The Mighty Quinn** (1 review): Reviewer thinks the encore Quinn was perfect, possibly the best version the band has played [6]

## The recordings

- **gd94-07-29.fob-beyer.miller.25582.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 192 min; rated 3.86/5 by 21 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the recording's sound quality very rich [12]
- **gd94-07-29.schoeps.dipietro.4078.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 181 min; rated 3.47/5 by 30 [3]. Said about its sound: Superb audience capture that conveys the sound of standing in the rain at the show; Front-of-board audience tape has lacking quality, possibly because an umbrella covered the microphones [7][10]
- **gd1994-07-29.schoeps.evans-gross.GEMS.91193.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 199 min; rated 3.75/5 by 8 [2]
- **gd1994-07-29.110975.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 184 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Phil walked out and waved broadly to the crowd standing in the rain, explaining the Rain opener [6]
- In-ear monitors worked poorly, so stage banter and song calls leaked over the PA [10]
- Reviewer says Garcia was barely a presence and Bobby's guitar dominated what is heard [11]
- Reviewer saw someone overdose in front of them early on, with a security guard shouting for a doctor [13]
- Reviewer's friend collapsed early in the first set; they dragged him through mud to the medical tent [14]
- The grounds were wet and muddy when this reviewer arrived late to their first show [15]
- Foolish Heart into I Want To Tell You was much improved over the 7-21-94 Deer Creek attempt [16]
- Reviewer ranks it among the better shows of the 1994 east/midwest run, though not amazing [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-07-29.fob-beyer.miller.25582.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Joe Totoraitis and Charlie Miller; source: Audience: Beyer M101 [1]. Also: Front-of-board recording with Beyer M101 omni mics, to Casio DA-7 DAT, then CD, EAC, SHN, by Charlie Miller [1]
- **gd94-07-29.schoeps.dipietro.4078.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by C. DiPietro; source: Audience: Schoeps MK4's [3]
- **gd1994-07-29.schoeps.evans-gross.GEMS.91193.flac16**: taped by Todd Evans & Adam Gross; transferred by Todd Evans and Jamie Waddell; source: Schoeps Omnis (on stands spaced 10ft apart) -> Schoeps Active Cables -> Schoeps CMC 3 Mic Body -> Monster M1000 Cable -> Oade Supply -> Monster M1000 Jumper ->… [2]
- **gd1994-07-29.110975.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Alan Schmit; transferred by Terry Watts; source: Source: (ORTF/110^/DFC/FOB) B&K 4011s > Neumann BS48i-2 > Modified Sony TCD-D10 Pro > DAT(m); [4]
